_about: 1-Butanol (1) + 1-Pentanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-butanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: J. Wang, Z. Bao, Investigation on vapor liquid equilibrium for 2-propanol + 1-butanol + 1-pentanol at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 341 (2013) 30-34
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 13, 14. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0050. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.28 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
